rules.rule: Phase 1 never commits, tags, pushes, or edits go.mod/go.sum
must: Never commit, tag, push, or edit a `go\.mod`/`go\.sum` in phase 1
Nothing has been committed or released

rules.rule: Code changes only as user-accepted fixes, only in plan modules, one change at a time
must: Edit code only as a fix the user accepted, and only in modules of the plan
Propose the fix one change at a time; apply only the changes the user accepts

rules.rule: Nothing is ever rolled back, in any phase or on abandon
must: Never roll anything back
roll nothing back
Nothing in the modules is rolled back

rules.rule: A skip module is never tested, updated, committed, or pushed; an in-place one is never tagged
must: A module marked `skip` \(`modes` in `ROOT/cascade/state\.json`\) is never tested, updated, committed, or pushed; one marked `in-place` is never tagged

rules.rule: Only the map pick, an ignore setting, the own-branch choice, and the preflight choice mark a module; a test failure offers fix or stop only
must: Only four things mark a module: the map pick, an ignore setting, the user's choice for a module on its own branch, and the user's choice for a dependent failing the preflight
Never offer a mark for anything else
offer only a fix or a stop; never offer `skip` or `in-place`

rules.rule: Phase 2 needs an explicit yes; anything else stops with the migration active
must: Anything but an explicit yes stops here with the migration active

rules.rule: One module at a time in plan order; stop at the first failure, except phase 1 build or test failures, which run the fix loop after every other module is tested
must: One module at a time, in plan order
stop at the first failure
The one exception: a phase 1 build or test failure runs the fix loop of Phase 1 step 4

rules.rule: Resume never plans again; the recorded plan holds for the whole migration
must: Never plan again: the recorded `ROOT/cascade/plan\.json` holds for the whole migration

rules.rule: Tests inherit GOWORK; GOWORK=off is dropped from ENV
must: Leave `GOWORK` alone: the go commands tests run inherit it
its `KEY=VALUE` lines but `GOWORK=off` are `ENV` below
A test failing under `ENV` stops the run like any other failure; never re-run it with `GOWORK` or `ENV` changed

rules.rule: In phase 2 the map pick is fixed and never offered for change
must: Phase 2: the pick is fixed; never offer to change it

rules.rule: Changed modules of unpicked maps wait in the session; a failing changed module's preflight ends the run
must: The changes of the others wait in the session for a later cascade
A failing changed module, or any stop, ends the run with the migration active

rules.rule: --recheck only once run.log has a test line
must: passing `--recheck` to the preflight when `ROOT/cascade/run\.log` has a `test` line and not otherwise

rules.rule: Resume tests every module again, passed ones included, the run reusing only unchanged passes
must: Test every module again, passed ones included

rules.rule: Start failing on an active migration stops and points at resume or abandon
must: it fails while a migration is active — stop and say so: `/cascade` resumes it, `/cascade abandon` ends it

rules.rule: A release not on origin stops the resume and is handed back
must: When that module's `pending` line says `release not on origin`, stop and hand back

rules.rule: Each fixed module's diff is shown and reviewed before the run goes on
must: Show each fixed module's `git diff` and wait for the user's review

rules.rule: An in-place module is pushed with git push origin HEAD, never bumped
must: Marked `in-place`: `git push origin HEAD`; log `-s push`; never bump
releases every module of the plan not marked `skip`, applications included, pushing the `in-place` ones without a tag

rules.rule: A bump with nothing to release is a release at the current tag, for every module
must: A `gomake :bump -u` with nothing to release counts, for every module: its current tag is the release

rules.rule: A dependent failing preflight gets skip, in place, or stop
must: skip it: left as it is
update it in place: updated on its branch
stop, to fix it by hand

rules.rule: Lessons are one general line naming no module of the run
must: append a one-line rule there — general, naming no module of the run

rules.rule: Report tersely: the step that runs, only what fails, never the modules that passed
must: Report tersely: say which step runs, show only what fails
never list the modules that passed

rules.rule: Phase 2 resume restarts the next module from its first step, update and tests included
must: continues at the module `next:` names, from its first step even when some steps already ran

rules.rule: Phase 2 rebases onto a moved origin and retests; never merges, never bumps or pushes a tree behind origin
must: Rebase, never merge: `git fetch origin` before a module's first step and
a local tag
Never bump or push a tree

rules.rule: Each release must be the highest version tag on origin; a higher one stops the run
must: After each bump, the release must be the highest version tag on origin
a higher one stops the run, handed back

rules.rule: Before the gate, find pseudo-version requirements and version-tied artifacts phase 1 cannot test, and settle them with the user
must: Find what phase 1 cannot test: the modfiles replace plan modules by
Settle each with the user before the gate

rules.rule: A phase 2 test failure that passed in phase 1 is rerun unchanged only on the user's word
must: and rerun unchanged only on the user's word

rules.rule: Commit messages are drafted in phase 1 and shown with the gate question, so the go-ahead covers them
must: :cascade:messages --dir ROOT` prints with the question, so the go-ahead
report none `missing` or `invalid`

rules.rule: A session checks every repository before changes and never fixes a failing one itself
must: `gomake :cascade:open --dir ROOT <tmp>`
never fix a repository yourself

rules.rule: A module on its own branch is settled with the user at plan time, before anything is tested
must: ask the user now, before anything is tested: skip it, update it in place, or stop

rules.rule: A pick leaving out roots a picked root requires is refused; the user adds their maps or stops
must: `picked changes need changes of unpicked maps:`
ask for a pick adding their maps, or a stop

rules.rule: A sync conflict stops the cascade and is left for the user to resolve
must: the conflict is the user's to resolve
